title: Universal 81/29 Bound for Tuza's Triangle-Cover Conjecture
description: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization proving 29 * tau(G) <= 81 * nu(G) (tau(G) <= (81 / 29) * nu(G) ~= 2.793103 * nu(G)) for every finite simple graph G, where nu(G) is the triangle packing number and tau(G) is the triangle transversal number, strictly improving Sichen Wang's 165/59 bound (arXiv:2609.13831). Main theorem: 1 of 1 in Lean (100%); companion 32-vertex gadget checked separately in exact rational Python. Extends Wang's MIT-licensed sichen-wang/tuza-lean library with helper-arborescence coupling, unmerged colored-family covers, and opposite-edge elimination, together with non-vacuity checks nu(K_4) = 1 and tau(K_4) = 2. Generated and checked by AI research agents built and directed by Tyler B. Hughes. No human mathematician has yet refereed the proof.
